_comment: EXAMPLE envelopes for Scripts/jev-arbiter-review.py.
Both envelopes are REFUSED unless bound: dataset_sha256 must equal the
Claims for the 2026-10-02 t2sol capture:
/root/aaemu-e2e-t2-sol/runtime/game/Logs/jev-shadow-v2-quest-perception-01.jsonl
OUTCOME envelope (--outcome-claims): observed facts only.
join  : exact-cycle      -> artifact carries the row's own cycle_id
identity-sequence -> matches bot/quest/run only; correlation, not proof
none             -> unbound assertion
class : authoritative-state -> read back from durable state
engine-log          -> the engine's own log line
actor-self-report   -> the actor describing its own success
reviewer-opinion    -> REFUSED here; belongs in a critique
CRITIQUE envelope (--critique): a named reviewer re-picks a LEGAL candidate.
A hard rejection in candidates[] is ILLEGAL and cannot be chosen.
definition NOT what the game took. Benefit is ALWAYS UNKNOWN: no
No Jev model produced any of this. No model caller is configured in this
repository; these are illustrative, human/agent-authored claims.
This file holds the OUTCOME envelope for --outcome-claims. The reviewer-side
envelope lives in jev-arbiter-review.critique.example.json; each carries its
own dataset_sha256 so the two can be supplied independently.

claims.claim: Quest 6198 left the active quest set during this wake, as recorded by the engine's own QuestManager finalization path in the same second as the row.
claims.basis: Server.log line 28663 carries this exact cycle_id; lines 28664-28673 show QuestManager EnqueueEvaluation/DoQueuedEvaluations plus '[Quest] for player: Qploopbff9dc60, quest: 6198 removed.' for char 1.

claims.claim: Quest 6198 was reported completed and its completed bit persisted across a restart, in a separate lane report for the same bot.
claims.basis: archive-pre-g7d report records stagedQuest.completedInSession=true and completedBitPersistedAfterRestart=true for questId 6198. That report carries NO cycle_id and NO trace id, so it joins on bot/quest/run identity and sequence, not on this exact wake.

claims.claim: Quest 251 was accepted and remained an active row after restart, in a separate lane report for the same bot.
claims.basis: archive-pre-g7d report records followUpQuest.accepted=true and activeRowPersistedAfterRestart=true for questId 251, with completed explicitly null and noted as 'not observed'. This corroborates that the accept took; it says nothing about what the accept was worth.
